target.title: fix(sessions): auto-generate session titles via AI summarization
target.body:
## Maintainer-ready notes

- Fix classification: Root-cause session-state/config feature fix and flagship rescue for an existing PR. This is not a narrow routine bugfix because the root contract crosses public config/schema, durable session metadata, model/auth routing, and session list behavior.
- Maintainer-ready confidence: High implementation confidence after current-head focused tests, architecture checks, ClawSweeper commit review, and real local gateway proof. Merge readiness still depends on maintainer approval of the product/privacy boundary for default-off background title generation.
- Root cause: The root cause was a missing single source-of-truth contract for generated session titles across storage, derivation, search, event refresh, UI filtering, and agent-facing session tools. Because generated title metadata was not consistently projected and re-used, downstream list/search paths could still derive titles from first-message/session-id fallback, and already-open session list consumers could miss background title writes until a later reload. During rescue, review also found the title completion path had to preserve prepared runtime auth application, and the public SDK runtime-auth helper had to avoid accepting internal credential selectors.
- Why this is root-cause fix: This fixes the state mapping contract at the source instead of masking display symptoms. `autoTitle` becomes the persisted generated-title field, `deriveSessionTitle` becomes the derivation boundary, gateway rows project/search the same metadata, background title writes notify the existing session-metadata change channel, session change events carry generated-title fields, Control UI consumes and patches the row-level derived title, `sessions_list` preserves `autoTitle` before transcript fallback, title completion applies prepared runtime auth, and the public SDK facade keeps runtime-auth parameters whitelisted.
- Patch quality notes: The async trigger catch is intentional because title generation is post-reply background work and must not fail or delay the user reply path; the generator logs failures. The generated-title notification is emitted only after the store write succeeds, so already-open session list consumers refresh from persisted metadata rather than speculative title output. The generator catch is limited to that background task. `return null` / `return false` paths are bounded transcript/title parser outcomes, not silent fallbacks for required config or auth. The `return {}` in the `sessions_list` test mock is only the non-`sessions.list` branch for that focused regression. The large diff is kept together because splitting config, metadata, gateway search, UI filtering, session event refresh, agent tool output, tests, and generated baseline would make the public contract inconsistent during review.
- Why it matters / User impact: Users with many sessions can identify sessions by concise generated titles instead of truncated first messages. Search can find sessions by the generated title across gateway/list consumers. Already-open session lists can receive the generated-title update after the background write instead of waiting for a manual reload. Agents using `sessions_list` receive the same generated title users see instead of a fallback title after a generated-title match.
- What did NOT change: Out of scope and unchanged: existing manual/display title precedence is preserved; existing sessions without `autoTitle` still fall back to first-message/session-id behavior; the feature remains controlled by `sessionTitle` config; no provider catalog, channel delivery, or plugin execution behavior is broadened.
- Architecture / source-of-truth check: Source-of-truth contract: session store metadata owns `autoTitle`; `deriveSessionTitle` owns title derivation fallback; gateway session listing owns cheap search/projection of session metadata; Control UI filtering consumes row-level derived titles; the agent-facing session tool preserves gateway row metadata before transcript fallback; internal runtime auth helpers may use selectors, but the public plugin SDK facade must not expose or forward selector fields.
- Related open PR / same-contract scan: This is a rescue/update of existing PR #87643 for #77165. #89705 is related prior PR context, not the issue this PR should close. After the main sync and upstream-fixed check, the complete contract covered here still needed this PR: generated title persistence, session-list derivation/search, agent-facing `sessions_list` preservation, config baseline, and auth-boundary fixes are kept together in this branch.
- Out of scope: Manual rename UI, existing-session backfill or migration, default-enabling title generation for all users, new provider/channel/plugin capabilities, and reworking session history storage beyond the minimal `autoTitle` metadata path.

## Summary

What problem does this PR solve?

- Sessions currently fall back to first-message truncation or session-id style titles, which makes old sessions hard to recognize.
- Generated title metadata was also not consistently carried through gateway rows, session change events, Control UI filtering/patching, and the agent-facing `sessions_list` tool.

Why does this matter now?

- #77165 requests concise automatically summarized session titles so session history is easier to scan and search.
- The existing PR had review blockers around exact-head proof, auth-provider routing, and title/search consistency that needed to be resolved before maintainer review.

What is the intended outcome?

- When `sessionTitle.enabled` is on, OpenClaw can create and persist a concise generated title for a session.
- Session list display/search paths can use that persisted title instead of falling back to first-message/session-id text.
- Title generation follows the session model/auth context, while the public plugin SDK runtime-auth helper keeps internal credential selectors private.

What is intentionally out of scope?

- No manual rename UI is added.
- No migration or backfill is added for existing sessions without `autoTitle`.
- No change is made to default-enable this feature beyond the documented `sessionTitle` configuration.
- No new provider, channel, or plugin capability is added.

What does success look like?

- A real gateway-created session can receive a persisted `autoTitle`.
- `sessions.list` returns a `derivedTitle` based on that generated title.
- Searching by the generated title finds the same session.
- Gateway, UI, and agent-facing session list surfaces preserve the generated title consistently, including already-open session lists that receive a post-write `sessions.changed` update.

What should reviewers focus on?

- The `sessionTitle` config contract and generated session metadata shape.
- Session model/auth routing for background title generation.
- Public SDK runtime-auth selector stripping.
- Generated-title search/list/refresh behavior across gateway events, Control UI filtering/patching, and `sessions_list`.

## Linked context

Which issue does this close?

Closes #77165

Which issues, PRs, or discussions are related?

Related #89705

Was this requested by a maintainer or owner?

This implements the behavior requested in #77165. #89705 is related prior PR context, not the issue this PR should close.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

- Behavior or issue addressed: a real gateway-created session can get a persisted generated title, expose that generated title as the derived session title, and be found by searching the generated title.
- Real environment tested: local OpenClaw gateway from this PR worktree with isolated home/state/config, real DeepSeek `openai-completions` model call, real gateway `agent`, `agent.wait`, and `sessions.list` calls.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```bash
DAILY_FIX_CONTEXT=[local context env] \
  $HOME/.claude/skills/daily-fix/scripts/daily_fix.sh run-validation \
    --name local-gateway-session-title-proof-final -- \
    bash [local proof script]
```

- Evidence after fix (screenshot, recording, terminal capture, console output, redacted runtime log, linked artifact, or copied live output):

```text
Validation `local-gateway-session-title-proof-final` (pass, exit_code=0, 92583ms):

[provider-transport-fetch] [model-fetch] start provider=deepseek api=openai-completions model=deepseek-chat method=POST url=https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions timeoutMs=undefined proxy=env policy=custom
[provider-transport-fetch] [model-fetch] response provider=deepseek api=openai-completions model=deepseek-chat status=200 elapsedMs=543 contentType=text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
proof=local-gateway-session-title status=passed
agent.wait status=ok
session row key=agent:main:daily-fix-title-proof-1782883544408 autoTitle="TITLE PROOF OK" derivedTitle="TITLE PROOF OK"
sessions.list search="TITLE" matched=true matchedDerivedTitle="TITLE PROOF OK"
```

- Observed result after fix: the real gateway run completed, title generation persisted `autoTitle`, `sessions.list` returned `derivedTitle` equal to `autoTitle`, and a generated-title search matched the same session.
- What was not tested: I did not manually click through the Control UI sidebar in a browser.
- Proof limitations or environment constraints: the proof uses gateway RPC to create the real session. The direct `agent` RPC path does not run the `get-reply-run` auto-title trigger, so the proof runner explicitly invokes the production `maybeGenerateSessionTitle()` after `agent.wait`; this validates the production title generator plus gateway list/search behavior, but not a full UI/manual-send auto-trigger path. Gateway token and provider API key were kept out of the PR body and proof output.
- Before evidence (optional but encouraged): before these changes, session list display/search paths could fall back to first-message/session-id titles, and the agent-facing `sessions_list` tool could match a generated title without returning that generated title.

## Tests and validation

Which commands did you run?

Focused validation commands run through the daily-fix validation wrapper:

- `config-docs-check` — passed after regenerating the tracked config baseline.
- `targeted-tests` — passed gateway, infra, auto-reply, plugin, and UI focused test groups.
- `check-architecture` — passed architecture/import/deprecated API/database guards.
- `config-schema-check` — passed generated config schema check.
- `public-sdk-auth-selectors` — passed after stripping internal credential selectors from the public helper boundary.
- `targeted-tests-after-sdk-fix` — passed the focused regression set after the SDK auth fix.
- `check-architecture-after-sdk-fix` — passed after the SDK auth fix.
- `generated-title-search` — passed gateway/UI generated-title search coverage after the fix.
- `check-architecture-after-title-search` — passed after generated-title search changes.
- `sessions-list-generated-title-green` — passed after preserving generated titles in the agent-facing session tool.
- `gateway-auto-title-lightweight-green` — passed after preserving `autoTitle` on lightweight gateway rows.
- `local-gateway-session-title-proof-final` — passed with the real local gateway proof shown above.
- `config-docs-check-after-squash` — passed on the squashed current head after syncing with latest `origin/main`.
- `targeted-tests-after-squash` — passed 9 focused test files / 465 tests covering session-title, auth-boundary, gateway search, UI filtering, and agent-facing session list behavior.
- `schema-and-architecture-after-squash` — passed generated config schema check and architecture/import/deprecated API/database guards on the squashed current head.
- `title-refresh-post-reply-green` — passed 4 focused test files / 196 tests covering the post-reply background title notification bridge, generated-title persistence notification, gateway event payload metadata, and Control UI event patching.
- `targeted-tests-after-latest-main-sync-squash` — passed 12 focused test files / 656 tests on clean single-commit head after syncing with latest `origin/main`, covering session-title generation, post-reply notification, auth-boundary, gateway search/event payload, UI filtering/event patching, and agent-facing session list behavior.
- `typecheck-after-latest-main-sync-squash` — passed the ClawSweeper-reported core `tsgo -p tsconfig.core.json` reproducer on the clean single-commit candidate after syncing with latest `origin/main`.
- `architecture-after-latest-main-sync-squash` — passed architecture/import/deprecated API/database guards on the clean single-commit candidate after syncing with latest `origin/main`.
- `config-checks-after-latest-main-sync-squash` — passed config baseline and generated config schema checks on the clean single-commit candidate after syncing with latest `origin/main`.
- `targeted-tests-after-final-single-commit-autotitle-reset` — passed 14 focused test files / 840 tests after clearing generated titles on reset/new/rollover paths.
- `typecheck-after-final-single-commit-autotitle-reset` — passed the core `tsgo -p tsconfig.core.json` check after the auto-title reset/rollover fixes.
- `architecture-after-final-single-commit-autotitle-reset` — passed architecture/import/deprecated API/database guards after the auto-title reset/rollover fixes.
- `config-checks-after-final-single-commit-autotitle-reset` — passed config baseline and generated config schema checks after the auto-title reset/rollover fixes.
- `targeted-tests-after-async-title-race-fix` — passed 14 focused test files / 841 tests after guarding background generated-title writes against session-key rotation.
- `typecheck-after-async-title-race-fix` — passed the core `tsgo -p tsconfig.core.json` check after the async stale-write guard.
- `architecture-after-async-title-race-fix` — passed architecture/import/deprecated API/database guards after the async stale-write guard.
- `config-checks-after-async-title-race-fix` — passed config baseline and generated config schema checks after the async stale-write guard.

Target test file

- `src/auto-reply/reply/session-title-generator.test.ts`
- `src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-run.media-only.test.ts`
- `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth-runtime.test.ts`
- `src/gateway/session-utils.test.ts`
- `src/gateway/server.sessions.list-changed.test.ts`
- `ui/src/ui/views/sessions.test.ts`
- `ui/src/ui/controllers/sessions.test.ts`
- `src/agents/openclaw-tools.sessions.test.ts`
- Existing focused suites covering auto-reply title generation, runtime model auth, config schema/docs, and architecture checks.

Scenario locked in

- Public SDK runtime-auth helper strips internal credential selectors.
- Gateway search matches persisted generated titles.
- Background title generation notifies callers only after the `autoTitle` store write succeeds.
- The post-reply path forwards generated-title metadata changes into the existing session metadata notification channel.
- `sessions.changed` payloads carry `autoTitle` and derived generated-title metadata.
- Lightweight gateway rows preserve `autoTitle` for downstream title derivation.
- Control UI session filtering can match generated derived titles, and event patching applies generated-title metadata to already-loaded rows.
- Agent-facing `sessions_list` returns generated titles when search matched the generated title.
- Reset/new and rollover paths clear transcript-derived generated titles instead of carrying stale `autoTitle` into the next session.
- Background title generation rechecks the current store row before writing, so a title generated for an old `sessionId` is not persisted after the same `sessionKey` rotates to a new session.
- Real local gateway proof shows persisted `autoTitle`, matching `derivedTitle`, and generated-title search hit.

Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail

These tests cover the cross-surface contract at the boundaries where regressions occurred: public SDK auth input, gateway list/search/event projection, UI filtering/event patching, agent tool rehydration, core type contracts, and real gateway/provider behavior. Lower-level unit coverage alone would not prove the session-list/search/refresh contract, and gateway proof alone would not lock the SDK/auth, typecheck, and tool regressions.

What regression coverage was added or updated?

- Public plugin SDK runtime-auth helper no longer forwards `agentDir`, `profileId`, `preferredProfile`, or `lockedProfile` into the internal runtime auth resolver.
- Gateway session search includes persisted generated `autoTitle` values.
- Background title generation emits a `session-title` metadata change only after persisting `autoTitle`.
- Generated-title persistence rechecks the current row's `sessionId` and title sources before writing, preventing stale async writes after `/new` or `/reset` rotates the stable `sessionKey`.
- Reset/new and rollover lifecycles clear transcript-derived `autoTitle` while preserving manual display names.
- The post-reply path forwards generated-title metadata changes to the existing session metadata notification hook.
- Gateway `sessions.changed` payloads include generated title metadata.
- Lightweight gateway session rows preserve `autoTitle` so downstream callers can derive the generated title without transcript fallback.
- Control UI session filtering includes generated `derivedTitle` values, and session event patching preserves `autoTitle` / `derivedTitle` on loaded rows.
- Agent-facing `sessions_list({ search, includeDerivedTitles: true })` preserves generated titles when the gateway matched a lightweight row by `autoTitle`.

What failed before this fix, if known?

- `red-public-sdk-auth-selectors` failed before the public SDK auth-boundary fix.
- `red-generated-title-search` failed before generated-title search support was added.
- `sessions-list-generated-title-red` failed before `sessions_list` preserved generated titles from lightweight rows.
- `gateway-auto-title-lightweight-red` failed before lightweight gateway rows preserved `autoTitle`.
- `red-title-refresh-event` failed before background title writes notified session-list consumers and before gateway/UI event payloads carried/applied `autoTitle` / `derivedTitle`.
- The post-reply bridge regression would not have observed any generated-title metadata change before `runPreparedReply` forwarded `onTitleGenerated` into the existing session metadata notification hook.

If no test was added, why not?

Not applicable. Regression tests and real gateway proof were added/run for the changed behavior.

## Risk checklist

Did user-visible behavior change? (`Yes/No`)

Yes.

Did config, environment, or migration behavior change? (`Yes/No`)

Yes — this adds/uses the `sessionTitle` config surface and refreshes generated config baseline data.

Did security, auth, secrets, network, or tool execution behavior change? (`Yes/No`)

Yes — title generation uses provider/model auth routing, and the PR touches the public runtime-auth SDK boundary.

Risk labels considered

- `merge-risk: compatibility`
- `merge-risk: auth-provider`
- `merge-risk: security-boundary`
- `impact: session-state`
- Public config/schema/data-format risk from `sessionTitle` and `autoTitle` metadata.

Risk explanation

The highest-risk areas are session model/auth routing for background title generation, public SDK auth boundary exposure, and search/list/refresh consistency across gateway rows, session change events, Control UI filtering/patching, and agent-facing `sessions_list` output.

Why acceptable

- Title generation uses the resolved session model/auth context while preserving manual/display title precedence.
- The public SDK helper now whitelists only `model`, `cfg`, and `workspaceDir`; selector-stripping regression coverage verifies internal selectors are not forwarded.
- Gateway, UI, and agent-facing session-list tests cover generated-title search, lightweight-row title preservation, session event payload metadata, and loaded-row event patching.
- The real gateway proof verifies a gateway-created session, real provider response, generated title persistence, derived title projection, and generated-title search without exposing secrets.

What is the highest-risk area?

- Session model/auth routing for background title generation.
- Public SDK auth boundary accidentally accepting internal credential selector fields.
- Search/list/refresh consistency across gateway rows, session change events, Control UI filtering/patching, and agent-facing `sessions_list` output.

How is that risk mitigated?

- Title generation uses the resolved session model/auth context while preserving manual/display title precedence.
- The public SDK helper now whitelists only `model`, `cfg`, and `workspaceDir`; selector-stripping regression coverage verifies internal selectors are not forwarded.
- Gateway, UI, and agent-facing session-list tests cover generated-title search, lightweight-row title preservation, session event payload metadata, and loaded-row event patching.
- The real gateway proof verifies a gateway-created session, real provider response, generated title persistence, derived title projection, and generated-title search without exposing secrets.

## Current review state

What is the next action?

Publish this updated branch/body through the daily-fix `local-submit-ready` and `submit-pr` gates, then let remote checks and maintainer review settle.

What is still waiting on author, maintainer, CI, or external proof?

- Author-side local blockers: none known after the current proof, final local validation, and local ClawSweeper commit review for head `13968bcce773d6b145e1c186c64ba9031216db19`. The latest local ClawSweeper commit review returned `result: nothing_found` / `check_conclusion: success`; the remote PR head still differs until this submit.
- Maintainer decision: RF-004 remains a product/privacy/config approval decision for the default-off `sessionTitle` surface and durable generated title metadata.
- Remote state: CI, mergeability, and labels need to settle after this branch/body update is submitted.
- External proof: the local gateway proof above is attached; no additional proof gap is known locally.

Which bot or reviewer comments were addressed?

- RF-001 (`status: waiting on author` label): addressed locally by refreshing proof, resolving review findings, and preparing this branch/body update; the remote label still needs to settle after submit.
- RF-002 (draft/dirty branch and exact-head checks): addressed by syncing with latest main, resolving conflicts, refreshing config baseline, squashing to one commit, and recording verification for current head `13968bcce773d6b145e1c186c64ba9031216db19`.
- RF-003 (prepared runtime auth model application dropped for label/title completions): addressed by applying prepared runtime auth to the completion model path and validating the auth-provider route.
- RF-004 (product/privacy boundary for config surface, durable metadata, and background transcript summarization): disclosed as a maintainer decision; the feature remains config-gated and the proof/risk sections describe the boundary.
- RF-005 (exact-head CI/proof refresh after mergeable branch): addressed locally by current-head verification and the `local-gateway-session-title-proof-final` run after the main sync.
- RF-006 (manual review needed because blockers mixed auth-provider regression and product/privacy approval): the auth-provider regression is fixed; the product/privacy decision is disclosed for maintainer review.
- RF-007 (apply prepared runtime auth to label completions): addressed in `src/auto-reply/reply/conversation-label-generator.ts` and covered by targeted validation.
- RF-008 (background generated-title writes did not refresh already-open session-list consumers): addressed by emitting a post-persist `session-title` metadata change, forwarding it from the post-reply path, carrying `autoTitle` / `derivedTitle` in `sessions.changed`, and applying those fields in Control UI row patches.
- RF-009 (local core typecheck found generated-title row contract mismatches): addressed by allowing optional `sessionId` in the title derivation input, adding `autoTitle` to the UI row contract, and hiding config IO's internal rollback symbol from the exported adapter type; `typecheck-after-latest-main-sync-squash` now passes.
- RF-010 (verify generated titles trigger a session-list update after a successful reply): addressed by the post-reply bridge regression in `get-reply-run.media-only.test.ts` and by `targeted-tests-after-latest-main-sync-squash`.
- RF-011 (verify `sessions.list` still returns `autoTitle`-derived `derivedTitle` and generated-title search hits after the notification fix): addressed by gateway/session tool generated-title search and lightweight-row regressions, plus `targeted-tests-after-latest-main-sync-squash` and the local gateway proof.
- RF-012 (verify event application or reload behavior preserves `derivedTitle` / `autoTitle` in Control UI without manual refresh): addressed by `sessions.changed` payload coverage and Control UI event patching coverage in `server.sessions.list-changed.test.ts` and `ui/src/ui/controllers/sessions.test.ts`.
- RF-013 (avoid overwriting transcript-derived titles with session-id fallbacks from lightweight mutation events): addressed by omitting `derivedTitle` from `sessions.changed` payloads when the event row has no reliable title source, while still emitting generated-title metadata when `autoTitle` or another title source is present.
- Latest local ClawSweeper commit review found no actionable code findings for current head `13968bcce773d6b145e1c186c64ba9031216db19`; it returned `result: nothing_found` / `check_conclusion: success`.
